title: Canopy leak at night 80 miles from the carrier
place_text: About 80 miles west of the aircraft carrier, 30,000 ft

tellings.quote: I was about 80 miles west of the boat, 30,000 feet or so, um, nighttime, and all of a sudden my canopy starts leaking.

plain: One night, about 80 miles west of his aircraft carrier and around 30,000 feet up, a Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says the canopy of his jet, the clear cover over the cockpit, suddenly began to leak. Graves tells it as something that happened to him on a flight, with no date given.
